results.title: Google Translate API Pricing Calculator (Jun 2026)
results.snippet: Document translation ($0.08/page) and LLM-based translation have no free tier. Google Cloud Translation pricing varies by API version and feature: Basic (v2) and Advanced (v3) NMT both cost $20 per million characters.

results.title: Google Translate API Pricing 2026: Full Breakdown
results.snippet: Google's free tier is 500,000 characters per month. A few things to know about it: It's permanent. Unlike the $300 GCP trial credit (which expires after 90 days), the 500K monthly allowance stays. It covers both v2 and v3 NMT translation.
